debate.key_bull_argument: Exceptional technical confluence (ADX 45.24, price above all major MAs, 15x volume spike, force index bullish cross) creates a powerful trend structure with strong entry quality despite overbought momentum readings.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis levels at 238.7, NFP volatility in 2 days), zero fundamental support (no insider conviction, earnings risk in 90 days), and elevated RSI/Stoch readings create unacceptable risk/reward in a fear-zone environment.
